lenses.label: Consulting and Transformation
lenses.opening: Regulated transformation delivery in European financial services, from regulatory reporting and central-bank audit to enterprise AI workflows, with the strategy carried through to an operating model.
lenses.conclusion: Most useful on transformation work where the strategy has to hold up in front of regulators, data owners and delivery teams.

lenses.label: AI Deployment and Adoption
lenses.opening: I take AI from a qualified use case to a controlled workflow, and define the baseline and measures that show whether it worked.
lenses.conclusion: Most useful where an AI capability has to become a workflow people adopt, with controls the risk function accepts and measures leaders trust.
lenses.honestGap: Adoption evidence is from programme delivery and designed operating models. I have not held a customer-success role with renewal or consumption targets.

lenses.label: Value Engineering and Presales
lenses.opening: Investment-grade financial judgement applied to AI decisions: cost of inaction, all-in platform economics, routing and rollout logic.
lenses.conclusion: Most useful in front of a CFO and CIO at the same table, where the value case and the architecture have to agree.

lenses.label: Partnerships and Ecosystem
lenses.opening: Proposition and go-to-market building inside a global firm, with capital-markets coordination across banking, legal and syndication teams behind it.
lenses.conclusion: Most useful where a partnership needs a credible joint proposition, delivery readiness on both sides, and commercial accountability.
lenses.honestGap: I have not held a formal partner or alliance management role. The closest evidence is internal go-to-market building and multi-party capital-markets execution.

lenses.label: Business Building and GTM
lenses.opening: I have built a local team and its regional go-to-market, and I build working prototypes to test a market hypothesis before asking anyone to scale it.
lenses.conclusion: Most useful in an early market where the hypothesis, the first customers and the operating model all have to be built at once.
lenses.honestGap: Market-building evidence is within a global firm and in independent prototypes. I have not owned a regional P&L or a revenue quota.

lenses.label: Risk and Resilience
lenses.opening: Non-financial risk, regulatory change and AI governance: RCSA, TPRM, DORA and model risk, with human authority designed in from the start.
lenses.conclusion: Most useful where risk, resilience and AI meet: digitising control work without weakening accountability.

lenses.label: Applied AI Solution Design
lenses.opening: Agentic workflows, model routing, evidence lineage and approval gates, designed and built as inspectable prototypes on synthetic data.
lenses.conclusion: Most useful as the person who turns an enterprise requirement into an architecture engineers can build and risk teams can approve.
lenses.honestGap: My builds are AI-assisted prototypes. I set the architecture, requirements, tests and review; I do not present myself as a production software engineer.
